Presente de indicativo

Used for actions happening now, habits, or general facts. Regular verbs drop the infinitive ending and add: -o, -as, -a, -amos, -áis, -an (-ar); -o, -es, -e, -emos, -éis, -en (-er); -o, -es, -e, -imos, -ís, -en (-ir).
